mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, resource_type, resource_code, tag_key, tag_value, created_by, created_at
mapper.select: select distinct tag_key from batch.resource_tag where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by tag_key

choose.when: select id from batch.workflow_definition where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_code = #{resourceCode} order by version desc, id desc limit 1

mapper.insert:
insert into batch.resource_tag ( tenant_id, resource_type, resource_code, tag_key, tag_value, created_by, created_at ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceCode}, #{tagKey}, #{tagValue}, #{operator}, current_timestamp ) on conflict (tenant_id, resource_type, resource_code, tag_key) do update
set tag_value = #{tagValue}, created_by = #{operator}, created_at = excluded.created_at
